lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular clusters distributed across the mid-lateral flank, forming a roughly rectilinear grid posterior to the branchial area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the circular blobs, establishing a structured pattern of high-contrast nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges on the upper flank characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient, with light-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical white linear striations, appearing as a series of parallel scratches or rake marks, situated on the upper lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive irregular high-luminance mottling and dense white blotching covering the majority of the visible pectoral fin surface.
